backward_compat_traps.rule: DSI v1.0 devices do NOT support EoTp; v1.01 devices SHALL provide enable/disable.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Always-on EoTp + v1.0 peripheral → DSI DT Not Recognized + lost packet boundary.

backward_compat_traps.rule: EoTp SHOULD NOT be sent in LP mode.
backward_compat_traps.trap: LP EoTp → DSI Protocol Violation or DT Not Recognized.
Emitting 0x0000 → Checksum Error on any v1.01 receiver.

backward_compat_traps.rule: Non-checksum peripheral SHALL transmit 0x0000 in Footer.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Receiver must disable Checksum check for such peripheral.

backward_compat_traps.rule: DSI v1.01.00 VC field is 2 bits (DI[7:6]); supports up to 4 VCs.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Confusion with CSI-2 v1.2+ widened VC; DSI v1.01.00 has NO VC extension.

backward_compat_traps.rule: P6/P7 of ECC byte SHALL be 0 by transmitter; receiver ignores and forces to 0.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Receivers including P6/P7 in syndrome mis-decode every header.

backward_compat_traps.rule: Trigger byte 0x5D is reserved for Tearing Effect only.
LRX-H_TO MUST be longer than LTX-P_TO.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Reversed → host times out before peripheral hands back bus.

backward_compat_traps.rule: DT[3:0] = 0b0000 or 0b1111 SHALL NOT be used.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Vendor custom DT must avoid these patterns.

fields.spec_version: MIPI DSI v1.01.00 (21-Feb-2008, MIPI Board Approved 18-Jun-2008)
previous_versions: D-PHY v0.9 (2007) — initial release; HS up to ~1 Gbps per lane.
D-PHY v1.0 (2009) — first production release; HS / LP definitions locked.
D-PHY v1.1 (2011) — added ULPS clarification; 4 Virtual Channels formalized.
D-PHY v1.2 (2014) — raised HS data-rate ceiling to 2.5 Gbps per lane; 16 Virtual Channels via VC extension.
CSI-2 v1.0 (2005) — initial CSI-2 release on D-PHY v0.9.
CSI-2 v1.1 (2009) — 4 VC; aligned with D-PHY v1.0.
CSI-2 v1.2 (2012) — Added RAW20, scrambling foundation.
CSI-2 v1.3 (2014) — Added RAW24; aligned with D-PHY v1.2.

key_changes.summary: ULPS state clarified; 4 VC enumerated; new T-CLK-PRE / T-CLK-POST constraints.
HS rate up to 2.5 Gbps; 16 VC via VC extension; deskew-pattern framework for >1.5 Gbps.
Added RAW20 data type; scrambling concept introduced for EMI reduction.
Added RAW24 data type; further scrambling support; aligned with D-PHY v1.2.
Added optional scrambling, improved error-handling, more data types.

fields.version_naming_history_note: MIPI Alliance maintains the DSI Display Serial Interface specification, the DCS Display Command Set, the DBI-2 / DPI-2 parallel display interfaces it supersedes, and the D-PHY physical layer specification. DSI v1.01.00 (Feb 2008) is the first revision to include EoTp. Subsequent DSI releases (v1.02 onward, v1.3, v2.x) — not covered by this document — added more pixel formats, higher data rates aligned with later D-PHY revisions, and additional command types.

key_changes_in_v1_01.summary: Added EoTp Short Packet (DT=0x08, payload 0x0F0F, ECC 0x01) as protocol-layer end-of-HS marker.
Aligned with D-PHY v0.90.00 (8-Oct-2007), DBI-2 v2.00, DPI-2 v2.00, DCS v1.02.00.
